item.title: Selichot at Western Wall: Over 50,000 worshippers gather ahead of Rosh Hashanah
item.description: Around 50,000 people attend late night Selichot service at the Western Wall. Rabbis and public figures pray for unity, the safety of Israel's soldiers and the recovery of the wounded.

item.title: Report: Two vessels attacked in Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said it had received a report of two vessels being attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, approximately 6.5 kilometers west of Khasab, Oman.
According to the agency, the crew of another vessel reported seeing four unidentified missiles strike the two vessels. A fire broke out on one of them, while the condition of the second vessel was unknown. UKMTO reports indicate that several vessels in the area have been affected in recent days amid ongoing military operations.

item.title: Following week-long pursuit: IDF apprehends terrorist planning imminent shooting attack
item.description:
Earlier today (Thursday), IDF soldiers, in conjunction with the Shin Bet, apprehended the terrorist Ismail Ankaio in the Beitunia area, along with an additional wanted individual.
Ankaio was planning to carry out an imminent shooting attack and was apprehended following a week-long pursuit of him.

item.title: Child collapses at mall, life saved by defibrillator
item.description: A child lost consciousness at a shopping center. A medic who arrived within two minutes treated him with two electric shocks, restoring his heartbeat.

item.title: US forces redirected 96 commercial vessels attempting to reach Iran
item.description: US Central Command says that as of Thursday, US forces have redirected 96 commercial vessels to ensure total compliance with the blockade of Iran. More than 50 vessels supporting humanitarian aid have been allowed to pass.
